title: Dimer model and random lattice permutations with general weights
summary: The dimer model and random lattice permutations are two fundamental objects at the interface of probability, combinatorics, and mathematical physics. We study these models on finite periodic boxes in $\mathbb Z^d$ within a common framework. For the dimer model, edges connecting arbitrary vertices carry a weight which depends on their relative displacement and dimer configurations are weighted through their occupied edges.
